title: rubus flagellaris var. humifusus
intro: Rubus flagellaris var. humifusus, commonly known as trailing blackberry or creeping blackberry, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It is a type of blackberry that grows close to the ground and produces edible fruits. The health benefits of Rubus flagellaris var. humifusus include its high antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of certain diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antidiabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins.
